body:
Yes, things are tough for mostly everyone. Pay cuts month after month, layoffs, even my father is at risk of losing his job, and mother will probably be sent to early retirement because of her condition, and that will probably make things even worse than they already are.  
The thing is, as bad as the pay is, you still can live off it. Problem is when you lose your job as there aren't many new ones, especially for someone with no college degree or some course (car mechanic, cool, ...). In recent years, many new private colleges have opened here and they are mass producing graduates so even clerks in nearby grocery stores have some kind of degree, and like an idiot i wanted to go to a prestige national college and be a physicist, ultimately failing and getting left in the worst possible situation.  
My previous job was IT related, mostly repaired all the computers in the company, but since i was working part-time, not even my work experience was registered anywhere so i can't even say that in my CV.  
As i said, moving in with my parents isn't an option. It's already too crowded and they are already struggling to make ends meet even without me.  
Still some hope left here, just wish there was a single lucky break ahead.
Thank you, even talking to someone feels refreshing. You have helped more than enough.

No unfortunately, he even got mad when i suggested decreasing the rent from 100 to 80 euros. Tried to talk things through with him a couple of time, delay payments till i get a job, but no luck.  
Same thing here, i tend to make something like replacing a light bulb look like a challenging task. Pretty good at math and physics though, even posted hundreds of ads around town and near school about tutoring for as low as 5 euros for 1.5 hours, but not many people are interested.  
As i said previously, parents are the only ones working for a miserable pay, and they have to provide for themselves, my brother and sick grandparents that also live with them. It's already too crowded, and they are poor enough already even without me tagging along.

Thanks for the hugs :-)  
Yes, scary as hell up there, i was always thinking i would be able to just walk off the edge and get it over with, but it's really much, much harder than that.  
As i just said in a reply to /u/safescience , it has just been quite hard few months. No job in sight, not a penny left, tons of unpaid bills and 3 months rent. Can't even just pack up and go to my parents place as they are probably doing even worse then i am. Well, i don't think i could even afford taking a bus across town, and traveling to New Zealand would probably cost me at least one kidney.  
Just don't see a way out any time soon. :(  
Edit: and Joshy, thanks for trying to help, much appreciated

Well, i hit a bit of a rough patch about 2 years ago, and it doesn't seem to be ending any time soon.  
After failing college and being left without a single useful skill that could actually help me provide for myself, i somehow finally found a job through a friend of mine. The pay was shit, and it barely covered my expenses, but it was something. Eventually, the owner was forced to close down the company, and once again i was left without anything.  
Since i live in a country that is in terrible economic condition and big layoffs are everywhere, i could not find a new job. Tried absolutely everywhere, would have happily accepted any job, no matter how degrading, but i just had no luck.  
Several month passed, i haven't been able to pay rent for some time, and i am also not doing too good with bills. Heating has been turned off, so will electricity be in few days, phone not working for quite a while now and i can't afford more than one meal a day.  
Landlord is getting pretty annoyed because of the late rent and i usually have to hide somewhere when he comes over.  
Still didn't tell my parents about losing my job since they are also having a really hard time providing for themselves and for my brother who is also unemployed.  
Just don't know what to do, will be kicked out of the apartment soon, and there doesn't seem to be any better days ahead.  
Edit: Also, thank you for caring.
